2. High-end GPUs (AX-9000 series) for AI/ML. These are likely controlled/advanced computing items. Country Q is sensitive for these.
3. Remote management tools with secure web-based access + optional remote performance tuning/troubleshooting by Apex engineers for three years. This could involve technology transfer, technical assistance, or ongoing access to systems in Country Q. This is a significant compliance concern.
